journey.name: A sequence of blocks
journey.description: Add a second block to the Timer's workout from the sets' sheet, give it a minute's work and a rest between the blocks in the editor, put it on the Timer, run the workout into the second block, and check what the notification says of the block. Save it as a preset from the editor and find it on Presets. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button and Work, Rest and Rounds rows
Tap the "Fewer rounds" button until the rounds read "×2"
Tap the "Sets" chip, then "Add a block" under the quick picks
Verify that the "Edit workout" sheet shows "Block 1" and "Block 2", each with Work, Rest and Rounds rows
In "Block 2", tap the Work row reading "0:30", tap the "1:00" quick pick, then "Done"
Tap the "Between blocks" row, tap the "0:30" quick pick, then "Done"
Tap "Done" at the foot of the editor
Verify that the Timer shows a card with "Block 1" reading "30s on · 15s off · ×2", "Block 2" reading "1m on · 15s off · ×2", "30s between blocks" and "Edit blocks", and the total reads 4:10
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready", then "Work" with "Block 1 of 2 · Round 1 of 2"
Tap "Skip" until the screen shows "Rest between blocks" with "Next: block 2 of 2 · 1:00"
Tap "Skip" and verify that the screen shows "Work" with "Block 2 of 2 · Round 1 of 2"
Press Home and verify that the notification reads "Work · Block 2 of 2 · Round 1 of 2"
Return to the workout, tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the summary says "Saved to history" and shows 2/4 rounds
Tap "Done", tap the Timer's block card, then "Save as preset" in the editor
Verify that the sheet is now "Save as preset" with a name field reading "30/15 ×2, then 1m/15 ×2" as its placeholder, then tap "Save"
Open "All presets" and verify that "30/15 ×2, then 1m/15 ×2" is under "Yours", reading "30s on · 15s off · ×2, then 1m on · 15s off · ×2 · 30s between blocks"
